name: CodeAlmanac
description: Turns your coding-agent conversations into a local-first codebase wiki, capturing architectural decisions and institutional knowledge that the source alone does not record.

skills.name: Wiki Generation
skills.description: Builds a browsable wiki of a codebase from agent transcripts, organizing explanations by subsystem.

skills.name: Decision Capture
skills.description: Records why a change was made, including rejected alternatives, so later agents inherit the reasoning.

skills.name: Local Web Viewer
skills.description: Serves the generated wiki from a local viewer, keeping proprietary code discussion entirely on your machine.
